title: Immersive Experience Designer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners choose VR, AR, or MR and three experience elements for a production-line showcase aimed at remote prospects, and get a specification with a technology-environment consistency check.

learningObjectives: Design an immersive storytelling experience by selecting the appropriate technology (VR, AR, MR) and defining the experience elements for a given scenario.
prerequisites: Story Virtual Reality, Story Augmented Reality, and Story Mixed Reality sections of Chapter 16

keyQuestions: Design an immersive storytelling experience by selecting the appropriate technology (VR, AR, MR) and defining the experience elements for a given scenario.
commonMisconceptions: All immersive tech is the same.
assessmentOpportunities: Recommended technology and elements chosen, with no consistency conflicts.
Learner can explain when AR is a better choice than VR.
